If you're running a business by yourself, this is the closest thing to hiring a full staff for $0.
There are free Claude skills for every single department that a company has, and I'm going to walk you through the five that I would set up first.
Real quick: a skill is just a markdown file, and it gives your agents specialized knowledge and workflows for how they can do specific tasks.
And the first department is marketing. Here is a collection of 45 different skills in one pack, and there are skills from ad creatives to copywriting.
Number two is social media. Here is a pack of 17 different skills, and they will help you write your scripts and help you with your thumbnails.
Number three is your design department. UI UX Pro is one that I love, and another one is called Taste. And this will help you and your brand create AI designs that don't actually look like AI.
And the fourth department is finance. This Claude plugin has eight different skills, and it can help you with financial statements or variance analysis.
And the last department is legal. This Claude plugin has nine different skills, and it can help you handle contracts and legal briefs.
Now, there's one part that I do think a lot of people skip. Do not just download these skills and let them sit there. Download the skill and hand it to your agent in Claude Code, and tell it to customize the skill specifically to how you and your business works. These skills are only going to save you time and save you money if you actually make them yours.
If you comment "department" down below, I'll send you the links to download all of these and tell you exactly how you can customize them
